rows.legal: IMPS24,829 SF S/S SIXES RD BOWENS
rows.headline: Inherited family house (Rose Hooper died 2012). Looks abandoned: SUV in the drive hasn't moved in years. Owners Sherri (daughter) and cousin Wayne are both alive.
owners: SHERRI HOOPER-TORRICELLI, 63 (Rose's daughter, the estate's personal representative). Phones (410) 535-0954 (old family landline), (410) 535-1220. Email tortor@hotmail.com

HOWARD WAYNE BUCKMASTER, 72 (born 4/1954; Rose's nephew = Sherri's first cousin). ALIVE: lives at 5180 Sandy Point Rd, Prince Frederick since 1993. Phones (410) 535-0955 mobile, (641) 660-5072 mobile, (410) 535-3843
rows.vesting: Joint tenants with right of survivorship: both must sign to sell; if one dies, the other owns it all
rows.deed: KPS 4308/321, personal representative's deed dated 10/28/2013, recorded 11/19/2013, no consideration. From the Estate of Rose Marie Hooper (Calvert estate #11763)
findings: Both owners are alive (skip trace 10/17/2026). SDAT lists only Sherri; Wayne is still on the deed, so he must sign too.

Rose Marie (Buckmaster) Hooper, 8/22/1931 to 3/18/2012, buried Asbury Methodist, Prince Frederick. Husband John Wesley Hooper (1928-1993). Rose's brother James O. 'Man' Buckmaster (1932-2016) was Wayne's father.

DRIVE-BY 10/17/2026 (Ray): the house is buried in brush. An old Mazda Tribute SUV with an old-style MD plate sits in the driveway, coated in mildew and moss, with fallen branches across it and a moss-covered drive with no tire tracks. It has not moved in years. That points to VACANT, or at least no one driving in or out.

OCCUPANCY: the skip trace has Sherri at 5000 Sixes from 1995 to now, on the family landline; she also used 3006 Abington Manor Dr, Huntingtown (Torricelli family, 2008-2018). SDAT codes it owner-occupied. She may be living in the overgrown house. Confirm before approaching.

CORRECTION: an earlier note tied her to Sherri Lynn Hooper of Glen Burnie (collection judgments, 2015 foreclosure, 2020 eviction). The skip trace does NOT support that (no Glen Burnie history, 0 judgments). Treat it as a different person.
No mortgage or deed of trust recorded since 2013.
Satellite shows the house fully under tree canopy; Ray saw it overgrown, possibly condemned-looking.
next_steps: Confirm no one is living there: look for a lit window, a path to the door, fresh mail or trash out. Or ask Calvert code enforcement whether the house is posted or condemned
Check Calvert tax status / 2026 tax-sale list
If vacant or Sherri wants out: soft call or letter to Sherri first, then Wayne (both must sign)
sources: Find a Grave 87429702 (Rose Marie Buckmaster Hooper)
Skip trace 10/17/2026 (Howard Wayne Buckmaster, Sherri Hooper Torricelli)

rows.legal: IMPS2 AC 1910 SIXES RD PRINCE FREDERICK
rows.headline: Florence K. Marshall, 86, now owns it alone: husband Wallace died 1990, and life tenant Frances E. King (her mother) is long deceased. One elderly signer; son James Gross also lists the address.
owners: FLORENCE K. MARSHALL, 86 (skip trace). Sole owner by survivorship. Phones (410) 713-0059, (410) 507-1353. Email florence.marshall@sbcglobal.net. Address history: 1910 Sixes Rd 1988 to now; PO Box 997 Prince Frederick 2011-2017

Wallace Marshall: DECEASED 5/15/1990 (SSDI and SS Claims: born 2/20/1934 in Warrenton VA; his skip-trace address history ends 5/15/1990). Tenancy by the entirety, so his share went to Florence automatically.

Frances E. King (life tenant): deceased. She was a widow by 1978 and appears in the 1920/1940/1950 censuses in Prince Frederick/Calvert, so she'd be about 120 now. Exact death date not found yet. Her life estate ended at her death; no probate needed.
rows.vesting: Florence K. Marshall now holds full title: life estate ended when Frances died, and the remainder was held with Wallace as tenants by the entirety, so as survivor Florence owns it all. To sell: record Frances's and Wallace's death certificates (or an affidavit), then Florence signs alone.
rows.deed: ABE 225/833, dated 1/31/1978, recorded 2/10/1978, $10. Elizabeth Portner, widow, to Frances E. King, widow (life estate), remainder to Florence K. Marshall & Wallace Marshall. Companion deed the same day: 225/831.
findings: Skip trace 10/17/2026: James Gross, 58, listed as Florence's CHILD at 1910 Sixes Rd. Phones (240) 607-9910, (410) 535-0510. He may be living there or helping her; likely the decision-maker alongside her.

Land Records: Frances E. King, Wallace Marshall and Florence Marshall signed mortgages together in 1985 (333/348), 1988 (454/678) and a deed of trust in 1990 (508/811, Dist 1). Releases recorded 1989 (469/8), 1999 (1182/167) and 2017 (5071/224, certificate of satisfaction). Likely all paid off; confirm 5071/224 covers the 1990 DOT.
Register of Wills (Calvert): no estate for Frances King, Wallace Marshall or Florence Marshall. That is normal for a life estate (passes outside probate), or they died elsewhere or are alive.
No obituary or Find a Grave match yet for Frances E. King, Florence K. Marshall or Wallace Marshall in Maryland. The Frances E. King obituaries online (Ohio, 2025) are different women.

SDAT: 1958 one-story, no basement, 1,152 sf on 2 acres, zoned RUR. Structure grade 1 (the LOWEST on the 1-9 scale). Assessed $181,600 ($125.5K land / $56.1K impr). Coded owner-occupied, but the homestead credit is not active.
SDAT still names Frances E. King and mails her the bill, so nobody ever updated the record after Frances died. Classic stale title.
next_steps: Confirm occupancy (Florence, 86, or son James Gross may live there) - Ray does not pursue occupied homes; if occupied, a soft, respectful approach only, or pass
Pull Frances E. King's death record (Calvert or MD Vital Records) for the title company
sources: MD Land Records (Calvert) ABE 225/833; name indexes for King, Frances and Marshall, Wallace
Register of Wills estate search (Calvert): King, Frances; Marshall
